protocol_proposal.byte_order: big-endian CDB and reply integers, raw page bytes unchanged

fields: sticky error; zero means no recorded error
current sector token; zero before arm
reply.identity_exception: FC78: echo@0, HYW1@2, version1@6, flags0@7, slotBE32@8, span32768BE32@12

commands.name: identity
commands.effect: Private RAM only; entry and identity perform no MMIO.

commands.name: initialize
commands.effect: Explicit reader-derived SPI setup, exact JEDEC and status checks; no WREN or status-register writes. Raw SR1/SR2 must be retained in an audit record before implementation is approved.

commands.name: arm_sector
commands.effect: Read all 4096 bytes and compare preimage CRC before issuing a fresh nonzero token and sequence1. No NVM mutation.

commands.name: erase_sector
commands.effect: One explicit 4KiB erase of the armed sector after a second preimage check; consume authorization before WREN. Read back every erased byte.

commands.name: stage_page
commands.effect: Receive256 raw page bytes plus CRC32BE into private RAM, validate complete reception and checksum, then retain staged data. No WREN. Query FC7E after OUT; no IN answer in the same transaction.

commands.name: program_staged_page
commands.effect: Consume staged page and sequence before WREN; require aligned unused page in the erased armed sector, revalidate RAM CRC and erased preimage, program once, wait bounded WIP, check status and compare all256 readback bytes.

commands.name: status
commands.effect: Return retained RAM status; never clears an error or repeats an operation.

commands.name: readback
commands.effect: Raw bounded read wholly within the application range. No other physical or CPU address space is exposed.

commands.name: finish_sector
commands.effect: Require all16 pages verified, read4096 bytes, match target CRC, invalidate the token and retain final result. No automatic next-sector arm.

sequence_rules: One active sector at a time; token and sequence must not wrap or be reused during a session.
Every accepted erase/stage/program/finish consumes exactly current_sequence+1 before its first external callback or SPI action.
Duplicate, stale, out-of-order or cross-sector commands fail closed; no retry or deduplication that can hide a repeated mutation.
A transport failure after authorization leaves completion ambiguous; only retained status and bounded readback may be requested.
On any error, invalidate staged data and mutation authorization. There is no command to clear a sticky failure.
Tokens are sequencing checks, not authentication or cryptographic nonces; a newly loaded plugin is a new session.
unresolved_before_runtime_implementation: ROM receive return/partial-transfer/error and buffer-lifetime semantics on this MINI.
Detailed retained audit-record schema including raw status bytes, operation counters, transfer return and guard checks.
Bounded poll counts tied to a reviewed erase/program timing budget; no unbounded WIP wait.
Malformed OUT framing/refusal policy without fallback into the ROM flash commands.
Host and target qualification evidence binding this exact writer, candidate image and unit backup.

receive_evidence.call_reference: src/loader.c:14-20: return discarded; unconditional pointer advance; chunks<=512
receive_evidence.limitation_reference: docs/SPEC.md:835: return values and partial-transfer/error semantics unknown

limitations: CRC/page tables are computed from local bytes; no device byte has been read by this tool.
This report does not qualify or change any hardware/readiness gate in another report.
CRC32 is not authentication and does not replace host SHA256 preimage/readback checks.
A sector interrupted during erase/program can be partially changed; no automatic rollback is claimed.
Mock NOR and target ELF tests are deferred because no writer runtime has been implemented.
